title: Liquidation or Limitation of Damages; Deposits
articleTitle: N.Y. UCC § 2-718 Liquidation or Limitation of Damages; Deposits
text: (1) Damages for breach by either party may be liquidated in the agreement but only at an amount which is reasonable in the light of the anticipated or actual harm caused by the breach, the difficulties of proof of loss, and the inconvenience or nonfeasibility of otherwise obtaining an adequate remedy. A term fixing unreasonably large liquidated damages is void as a penalty.
